Blurb: The forces of the People's Republic of China enter Chengdu, ending the Southwest Campaign against the Republic of China and completing the conquest of major continental Han-inhabited territories.

Title: United States of Indonesia
Blurb: Indonesia becomes a federation, the Republic of the United States of Indonesia, and its independence is formally recognised by the Netherlands. The capital returns to Jakarta from Yogyakarta; Western New Guinea remains Dutch as Netherlands New Guinea.

Title: West Jerusalem
Blurb: The State of Israel moves its Parliament, the Knesset, from Tel Aviv to the National Institutions House in West Jerusalem.

Title: European Union
Blurb: European integration began in earnest in the 1950s in France and Germany, and eventually led to the European Union, a political and economic union that comprised 15 countries at the end of the 20th century.

Title: Green Revolution
Blurb: Norman Borlaug fathered the Green Revolution, a set of research and technology transfer initiatives between 1950 and the late 1960s that sharply increased agricultural production and is often credited with saving over a billion people from starvation.

Title: Qutbism
Blurb: 1950s - Sayyid Qutb articulates Qutbism, a violent variety of Islamism that would later become foundational to jihadist ideology. Maharishi Mahesh Yogi begins to teach Transcendental Meditation.

Title: Spanish West Africa
Blurb: Spanish West Africa is disestablished: the province of Cape Juby is ceded to the Kingdom of Morocco, and the provinces of Rio de Oro and Saguia el-Hamra become Spanish Sahara.

Title: India
Blurb: India adopts a republican constitution and changes its name to the Republic of India, becoming the first republic in the Commonwealth of Nations.

Title: Yunnan
Blurb: The People's Republic of China completes the conquest of southern Yunnan, expelling the Republic of China from all of continental China Proper.

Title: Somalia
Blurb: The British-occupied territory of Italian Somaliland is transferred to Italy as the Trust Territory of Somalia.

Title: Xikang
Blurb: The People's Republic of China completes the conquest of Xikang, defeating the last regular forces of the Republic of China in continental Mainland China.

Title: Hainan
Blurb: The People's Republic of China completes the conquest of Hainan Island from the Republic of China.

Title: Korea
Blurb: Cold War proxy war in Korea, fought from 1950 to 1953.

Title: Wanshan Archipelago
Blurb: The People's Republic of China completes the conquest of the Wanshan Archipelago from the Republic of China, concluding the main period of hostilities in the Chinese Civil War.

Title: Indonesia
Blurb: The Republic of the United States of Indonesia becomes a unitary state and changes its name back to the Republic of Indonesia.

Title: Ambon
Blurb: Indonesia reconquers Ambon, the last stronghold of the Republic of South Maluku, reducing the separatist movement to a minor insurgency.

Title: Sikkim
Blurb: The Kingdom of Sikkim signs a treaty to become a protectorate of India.

Title: Ryukyu Islands
Blurb: The United States reorganizes the United States Military Government of the Ryukyu Islands as the United States Civil Administration of the Ryukyu Islands.

Title: Thule Air Base
Blurb: Denmark leases Thule Air Base in Greenland to the United States in perpetuity and cedes exclusive jurisdiction over the base area.

Title: Tibet
Blurb: The People's Republic of China annexes the de facto independent state of Tibet after the military conquest of its Chamdo Region in October 1950.

Title: Poland
Blurb: The Republic of Poland and the Soviet Union exchange territory along their common border.

Title: Mozambique
Blurb: Due to Portuguese colonies being reorganized as overseas provinces, Portuguese East Africa is renamed Mozambique and Portuguese West Africa is renamed Angola.

Title: Ifni
Blurb: Spain incorporates the protectorate of Ifni as a region of Spanish West Africa.

Title: Greece and Turkey
Blurb: Greece and Turkey join the North Atlantic Treaty Organization in the alliance's first enlargement.

Title: Japan
Blurb: The Allied occupation of Japan ends.

Title: Poland
Blurb: The Republic of Poland changes its name to the Polish People's Republic.

Title: European Coal and Steel Community
Blurb: The European Coal and Steel Community, the earliest predecessor to the European Union, is created. Italy, France, Luxembourg, Belgium, the Netherlands and West Germany are the founding members.

Title: Hondo Valley
Blurb: The Argentine National Gendarmerie took control of the disputed areas between Argentina and Chile in Hondo Valley, Horquetas Valley and Lagunas del Engano, prompting a diplomatic protest from Chile.

Title: Eritrea
Blurb: Italian Eritrea is federated within the Ethiopian Empire.

Title: Church of Scientology
Blurb: 1953 - L. Ron Hubbard founds the Church of Scientology, which has a unique cosmology based on science fiction and his older system of Dianetics.

Title: DNA
Blurb: The structure of DNA was determined in 1953 by James Watson, Francis Crick, Rosalind Franklin and Maurice Wilkins, followed by developing techniques which allow reading DNA sequences and culminating in starting the Human Genome Project and cloning the first mammal in 1996.

Title: Maldives
Blurb: The First Republic of Maldives supersedes the Sultanate of Maldives.

Title: Estonian Government in Exile
Blurb: The Estonian Government in Exile is established, in parallel to Estonian diplomatic legations abroad. Both are later declared keepers of the legal continuity of the restored Republic of Estonia.

Title: Venezuela
Blurb: The United States of Venezuela is renamed the Republic of Venezuela.

Title: United Kingdom
Blurb: 1953 saw the coronation of Queen Elizabeth II, an iconic figure of the century.

Title: Egypt
Blurb: The Egyptian Republic supersedes the Kingdom of Egypt.

Title: Cuba
Blurb: The Cuban Revolution is led by Fidel Castro to overthrow Fulgencio Batista's regime.

Title: Laos
Blurb: The Kingdom of Laos gains independence from France. Vientiane is the capital.

Title: Amami Islands
Blurb: The United States returns the Amami Islands to Japan.

Title: British Doctors Study
Blurb: The role of tobacco smoking in the causation of cancer and other diseases was proven during the 1950s (see British Doctors Study).

Title: Maldives
Blurb: The Sultanate of Maldives supersedes the First Republic of Maldives.

Title: Vietnam
Blurb: The Geneva Accords grant independence to Vietnam, which is provisionally divided into North Vietnam and South Vietnam.

Title: Vietnam
Blurb: France recognizes the independence of Vietnam divided between the Democratic Republic of Vietnam (North Vietnam) and the Republic of Vietnam (South Vietnam). Hanoi and Saigon are the respective capitals.

Title: Free Dadra
Blurb: The Free Dadra declares independence from Portugal, but is officially recognized only by India.

Title: Silvassa
Blurb: The capital of Free Dadra is moved from Dadra to Silvassa.

Title: Dadra and Nagar Haveli
Blurb: The Republic of India annexes Dadra and Nagar Haveli from Portuguese India.

Title: Free Territory of Trieste
Blurb: The Free Territory of Trieste is divided between Italy and Yugoslavia.

Title: Oman
Blurb: Amidst a civil war, the Imamate of Oman declares the dissolution of the union of Muscat and Oman and applies for membership in the Arab League as the independent Kingdom of Oman. Nizwa remains the capital.

Title: Cambodia
Blurb: France recognizes the independence of the Kingdom of Cambodia. Phnom Penh remains the capital.

Title: Yijiangshan Islands
Blurb: The People's Republic of China conquers the Yijiangshan Islands from the Republic of China after the Battle of Yijiangshan Islands.

Title: Dachen Islands
Blurb: The People's Republic of China takes control of the Dachen Islands, Yushan Islands, Pishan Islands, and Nanji Islands after the Republic of China withdraws from these territories judged indefensible.

Title: Panama Canal Zone
Blurb: The corridor of Panama inside the Panama Canal Zone, part of the United States of America, is slightly shifted by territorial exchanges due to bridges and highways.

Title: West Germany
Blurb: West Germany joins the North Atlantic Treaty Organization in the alliance's second enlargement.

Title: Warsaw
Blurb: The Warsaw Pact is founded, led by the Soviet Union as their equivalent to the North Atlantic Treaty Organization for the Eastern Bloc. Albania, Bulgaria, Czechoslovakia, East Germany, Hungary, Poland, Romania and the Soviet Union are the founding members.

Title: Austria
Blurb: The Republic of Austria regains its independence with the end of Allied occupation. Vienna is the capital.

Title: Bach Long Vi Island
Blurb: Following the withdrawal of French forces in August 1954, the People's Republic of China conquers Bach Long Vi Island from the Republic of China.

Title: French Southern and Antarctic Lands
Blurb: The French overseas territory of Adelie Land and the Malagasy dependencies of the Crozet Islands, the Kerguelen Islands, and Saint-Paul and Amsterdam merge to form the French Southern and Antarctic Lands.

Title: Panama Canal Zone
Blurb: The border between Panama and the United States' Panama Canal Zone is redefined, resulting in several border changes. Punta Paitilla, the land held on Taboga Island, and the remaining American holdings in Colon and Panama City are ceded to Panama.

Title: Rockall
Blurb: Rockall is officially claimed by the United Kingdom.

Title: Cocos (Keeling) Islands
Blurb: The United Kingdom transfers the Cocos or Keeling Islands of the Colony of Singapore to Australia as the Territory of Cocos (Keeling) Islands.

Title: Cardiff
Blurb: Cardiff is recognised as the capital of Wales, the country's first official capital since 1689.

Title: San Felipe banco
Blurb: The United States of America annexes the San Felipe banco from Mexico.

Title: Morocco
Blurb: The Sherifian Empire gains independence from France. Rabat is the capital.

Title: Pakistan
Blurb: Pakistan adopts a new constitution and changes its name to the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, and remains part of the Commonwealth of Nations.

Title: Spanish Morocco
Blurb: Spanish Morocco becomes part of the Sherifian Empire.

Title: Egypt
Blurb: The Egyptian Republic declares its complete independence from the United Kingdom.

Title: Hungary
Blurb: Beginning of the Hungarian Revolution of 1956.

Title: Polish People's Republic
Blurb: 1956 Poznan protests, the first of several massive protests against the communist government of the Polish People's Republic.

Title: Karelia
Blurb: The Karelo-Finnish Soviet Socialist Republic is made part of the Russian SFSR.

Title: Dalit Buddhist movement
Blurb: 1956 - B. R. Ambedkar launches the Dalit Buddhist movement.

Title: Egypt
Blurb: France, Britain and Israel invade Egypt in the Suez Crisis.

Title: Tangier
Blurb: The Tangier International Zone, under the joint administration of France, Spain, the United Kingdom, Italy, Portugal, and Belgium, is reintegrated into the Sherifian Empire.

Title: Hungary
Blurb: Hungary withdraws from the Warsaw Pact as part of the ongoing revolution.

Title: Hungary
Blurb: The Soviet Union invades and occupies Hungary to end the revolution. A new government is established.

Title: Sinai Peninsula
Blurb: Fighting in the Suez Crisis ends. Israel occupies the Sinai Peninsula of Egypt.

Title: British Togoland
Blurb: British Togoland is merged into the Gold Coast.

Title: Saarland
Blurb: Saar is given to West Germany as the state of Saarland.

Title: Vietnam
Blurb: The Vietnam War caused two million deaths, changed the dynamics between the Eastern and Western Blocs, and altered global North-South relations. Fought from 1957 to 1975.

Title: Bach Long Vi Island
Blurb: The People's Republic of China transfers Bach Long Vi Island to North Vietnam.

Title: Argentine Antarctica
Blurb: Argentina declares the Argentine Antarctic Sector between the meridians 25 degrees W and 74 degrees W.

Title: Sinai Peninsula
Blurb: Israel withdraws from Sinai, returning it to Egyptian control.

Title: Tunisia
Blurb: The Kingdom of Tunisia is renamed the Republic of Tunisia.

Title: Morocco
Blurb: The Sherifian Empire is renamed the Kingdom of Morocco.

Title: Malaya
Blurb: The Federation of Malaya gains independence from the United Kingdom. Kuala Lumpur is the capital, and Malaya becomes the first native monarchy in the Commonwealth of Nations.

Title: Ifni
Blurb: Morocco invades Ifni, conquering most of the region beyond the vicinity of Sidi Ifni from Spain by December, and occupying it until Spain cedes the entire region in 1969.

Title: Christmas Island
Blurb: The United Kingdom separates Christmas Island from the Colony of Singapore to form the Colony of Christmas Island.

Title: Togo
Blurb: The French-administered United Nations Trust Territory of French Togoland is renamed Togo.

Title: West Indies Federation
Blurb: The United Kingdom establishes the West Indies Federation as a federation of most of the British West Indies, excluding the British Virgin Islands and the Bahamas. The de jure capital is Chaguaramas on Trinidad and the de facto capital is Port of Spain.
Place: Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago

Title: Ifni Province
Blurb: Ifni is separated from Spanish West Africa as Ifni Province.

Title: Beagle Channel
Blurb: The Snipe incident starts between Argentina and Chile in the Beagle Channel, in which the two countries disagreed about sovereign rights over the zone and the islet of Snipe.

Title: Arab Federation of Iraq and Jordan
Blurb: The Hashemite Kingdom of Iraq and the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan unite to form the Arab Federation of Iraq and Jordan. Amman yields to Baghdad as the capital.

Title: United Arab States
Blurb: The United Arab States is formed as a confederation between the United Arab Republic (Egypt and Syria) and the Kingdom of Yemen.

Title: Moroni
Blurb: The French Territory of the Comoros votes to move its capital from Dzaoudzi to Moroni. The actual move occurs gradually by 1966.

Title: Iraq
Blurb: The Republic of Iraq and the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan are created from the dissolution of the Arab Federation of Iraq and Jordan. The Republic of Iraq is created by the 14 July Revolution in which King Faisal II was murdered.

Title: Christmas Island
Blurb: Sovereignty over the Colony of Christmas Island is transferred from the United Kingdom to Australia as the Territory of Christmas Island.

Title: Madagascar
Blurb: The Malagasy Republic (Madagascar) gains autonomy within the French Community. Antananarivo is the capital.

Title: North Korea
Blurb: The People's Republic of China completely withdraws its forces from North Korea, ending its eight-year-long military presence in the Korean Peninsula.

Title: Rio Encuentro-Alto Palena
Blurb: The Argentine Gendarmerie re-enter the Horquetas and Hondo Valley inside the disputed area between Argentina and Chile denominated as Rio Encuentro-Alto Palena.

Title: Romania
Blurb: The Soviet Union completely withdraws its forces from Romania, ending a 14-year-long occupation.

Title: Central African Republic
Blurb: The French colony of Ubangi-Shari joins the French Community as the Central African Republic.

Title: Ivory Coast
Blurb: The French colony of Ivory Coast joins the French Community.

Title: Gwadar
Blurb: Sovereignty over Gwadar is transferred from the Sultanate of Muscat and Oman to Pakistan.

Title: Upper Volta
Blurb: The French colony of Upper Volta joins the French Community.

Title: Niger
Blurb: The French colony of Niger joins the French Community.

Title: Bhutanese enclaves in Tibet
Blurb: The Bhutanese enclaves within Tibet are taken over by the People's Republic of China.

Title: China
Blurb: Mao Zedong's radical policy of modernization led to the Great Chinese Famine causing the death of tens of millions of Chinese peasants between 1959 and 1962. It is thought to be the largest famine in human history.

Title: Cuba
Blurb: The Cuban revolution ends with 26th of July Movement victory and a new regime led by the Communist Party of Cuba.

Title: Alaska
Blurb: Alaska is admitted to the Union as the 49th State of the United States.

Title: United Suvadive Republic
Blurb: The United Suvadive Republic secedes from the Sultanate of Maldives. Hithadhoo is the capital.

Title: Oman
Blurb: The forces of the United Kingdom and the Sultanate of Muscat conquer the last strongholds of the Kingdom of Oman, reincorporating the Imamate into Muscat and Oman. Muscat effectively becomes the joint capital.

Title: Mali Federation
Blurb: In French Africa, the colonies of Senegal and Soudan merge to form the Mali Federation.

Title: Singapore
Blurb: The United Kingdom changes the name of the Colony of Singapore to the State of Singapore.

Title: Spanish Guinea
Blurb: Fernando Po and Rio Muni are merged to form Spanish Guinea.

Title: Hawaii
Blurb: Hawaii is admitted to the Union as the 50th State of the United States.

Title: Africa and Asia
Blurb: The end of colonialism led to the independence of many African and Asian countries, from the two largest colonial empires in the world, the British and French colonial empires. During the Cold War, many of these aligned with the United States, the USSR, or China for defense.

Title: Anglicanism
Blurb: 1960 - The charismatic movement starts within Anglicanism, quickly spreading to other Christian sects.

Title: British Leeward Islands
Blurb: The British Leeward Islands are dissolved into the British colonies of Antigua, Montserrat, Saint Christopher, Nevis and Anguilla, and the British Virgin Islands.

Title: British Virgin Islands
Blurb: The British Virgin Islands becomes a separate crown colony while the other islands remain within the West Indies Federation.

Title: British Windward Islands
Blurb: The British Windward Islands are dissolved into the British colonies of Dominica, Grenada, Saint Lucia, and Saint Vincent.

Title: Cameroun
Blurb: The Republic of Cameroun gains independence from the French Republic. Yaounde remains the capital.

Title: Scattered Islands in the Indian Ocean
Blurb: France detaches the Scattered Islands in the Indian Ocean from the Malagasy Republic shortly before its independence. In September the administration of the Scattered Islands is delegated to the Prefect of Reunion.

Title: Brasilia
Blurb: The Republic of the United States of Brazil moves its capital from Rio de Janeiro to Brasilia.

Title: Mali Federation
Blurb: The Mali Federation gains independence from the French Republic. Dakar remains the capital.

Title: Somaliland
Blurb: British Somaliland gains independence from the United Kingdom temporarily as the State of Somaliland, in preparation for union with the Trust Territory of Somaliland. Hargeisa remains the capital.

Title: Ghana
Blurb: Ghana changes its name to the Republic of Ghana and severs all ties to the British monarchy as a Commonwealth realm, remaining part of the Commonwealth of Nations.

Title: Czechoslovakia
Blurb: The Czechoslovak Republic changes its name to the Czechoslovak Socialist Republic.

Title: Katanga
Blurb: The State of Katanga declares independence from the Republic of the Congo (Leopoldville) with no recognition.

Title: Dahomey
Blurb: The Republic of Dahomey gains independence from the French Republic. Porto-Novo remains the capital.

Title: Rawalpindi
Blurb: The capital of Pakistan is moved from Karachi to Rawalpindi.

Title: Upper Volta
Blurb: The Republic of Upper Volta gains independence from the French Republic. Ouagadougou remains the capital.

Title: Cote d'Ivoire
Blurb: The Cote d'Ivoire gains independence from the French Republic. Abidjan remains the capital.

Title: Congo-Brazzaville
Blurb: The Republic of the Congo (Congo-Brazzaville) gains independence from the French Republic. Brazzaville remains the capital.

Title: China-Burma border
Blurb: The People's Republic of China is ceded 340 square kilometres of territory and Burma is ceded 220 square kilometres of territory in a boundary treaty delimiting the borders between the two countries.

Title: Nigeria
Blurb: The Federation of Nigeria achieves independence from the United Kingdom as a Commonwealth realm. Lagos continues to serve as the capital, and Nigeria begins administering the Bakassi Peninsula, formerly part of British Cameroons.

Title: Mauritania
Blurb: The Islamic Republic of Mauritania gains independence from the French Republic. Nouakchott remains the capital.

Title: Dadra and Nagar Haveli
Blurb: The Free Dadra and Nagar Haveli joins India, as Portugal ceases to claim it.

Title: Sao Joao Baptista de Ajuda
Blurb: Portugal cedes Sao Joao Baptista de Ajuda (now Ouidah) to Dahomey, which annexes the fort.

Title: Portuguese India
Blurb: India annexes Portuguese India, and Portugal maintains its claims to it.

Title: Vostok 1
Blurb: The Space Race between the United States and the Soviet Union gave a peaceful outlet to the political and military tensions of the Cold War, leading to the first human spaceflight with the Soviet Union's Vostok 1 mission in 1961.

Title: Sierra Leone
Blurb: Sierra Leone gains independence from the United Kingdom. Freetown remains the capital.

Title: South Africa
Blurb: The Union of South Africa ceases to be a Commonwealth realm and changes its name to the Republic of South Africa. South Africa temporarily withdraws from the Commonwealth of Nations as a result.

Title: Northern Cameroons
Blurb: Northern Cameroons joins Nigeria.

Title: Kuwait
Blurb: The State of Kuwait gains independence from the United Kingdom. Kuwait City remains the capital.

Title: Antarctica
Blurb: The Antarctic Treaty System enters force to administer the continent of Antarctica and all lands and waters south of the 60th parallel south.

Title: Syria
Blurb: In the United Arab States, Syria leaves the United Arab Republic and returns to the name of the Syrian Arab Republic.

Title: Cameroon
Blurb: The southern portion of the British Cameroons gains independence from the United Kingdom and unites with the Republic of Cameroun to form the Federal Republic of Cameroon. Yaounde remains the capital.

Title: West Papua
Blurb: The Netherlands New Guinea is renamed West Papua.

Title: South Kasai
Blurb: South Kasai is taken back by Congo (Leopoldville).

Title: Western Samoa
Blurb: The Independent State of Western Samoa gains independence from New Zealand. Apia remains the capital.

Title: West Indies Federation
Blurb: The West Indies Federation is dissolved and member states return to their status as parts of the British West Indies.
Place: Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago

Title: Cayman Islands
Blurb: The United Kingdom creates the Crown Colonies of the Cayman Islands and the Turks and Caicos Islands from Jamaica. George Town and Cockburn Town are the respective capitals.

Title: Algeria
Blurb: Algeria becomes the People's Democratic Algerian Republic.

Title: Sana'a
Blurb: The capital of the Mutawakkilite Kingdom of Yemen is moved from Ta'izz to Sana'a.

Title: Yemen Arab Republic
Blurb: The Mutawakkilite Kingdom of Yemen (North Yemen) is overthrown by the Yemen Arab Republic. Sana'a becomes the capital.

Title: West New Guinea
Blurb: West Papua is transferred from the Netherlands to UN authority as West New Guinea.

Title: Second Vatican Council
Blurb: 1962-65 - The Second Vatican Council is held, resulting in significant changes in the Catholic Church.

Title: Eritrea
Blurb: Eritrea becomes a province of the Ethiopian Empire, losing the autonomy it had under federation.

Title: Aksai Chin
Blurb: The People's Republic of China imposes a ceasefire after conquering all of Aksai Chin. India continues to claim the territory.

Title: Tanganyika
Blurb: Tanganyika is renamed the Republic of Tanganyika and severs all ties to the British monarchy as a Commonwealth realm, but remains in the Commonwealth of Nations.

Title: Katanga
Blurb: Katanga is taken back by Congo (Leopoldville).

Title: Trans-Karakoram Tract
Blurb: The People's Republic of China is ceded the Trans-Karakoram Tract by Pakistan. India continues to claim the territory.

Title: Yugoslavia
Blurb: The Federal People's Republic of Yugoslavia changes its name to the Socialist Federal Republic of Yugoslavia.

Title: Libya
Blurb: The Kingdom of Libya supersedes the United Kingdom of Libya.

Title: Irian Barat
Blurb: West New Guinea is provisionally transferred from United Nations Temporary Executive Authority to Indonesian administration as the province of Irian Barat, pending the fulfillment of the New York Agreement.

Title: Rwenzururu
Blurb: The Kingdom of Rwenzururu declares independence from Uganda with no recognition.

Title: Singapore
Blurb: The State of Singapore declares de facto independence from the United Kingdom.

Title: United Suvadive Republic
Blurb: The United Suvadive Republic is reunited with the Sultanate of Maldives. Hithadhoo yields to Male as the capital.

Title: Zanzibar
Blurb: The Sultanate of Zanzibar gains independence from the United Kingdom. Zanzibar City remains the capital.

Title: Rhodesia and Nyasaland
Blurb: The Federation of Rhodesia and Nyasaland is divided into Northern Rhodesia, Southern Rhodesia, and Nyasaland.

Title: Zanzibar and Pemba
Blurb: The People's Republic of Zanzibar and Pemba is established after a revolution overthrows the Sultanate of Zanzibar.

Title: Chamizal
Blurb: The Chamizal is split between Mexico and the United States of America.

Title: United Nations Buffer Zone in Cyprus
Blurb: The United Nations Buffer Zone in Cyprus is established in the Republic of Cyprus between Greek Cypriot and Turkish Cypriot communities.

Title: Romania
Blurb: The Romanian People's Republic gains full economic and political independence from the Soviet Union. Bucharest remains the capital.

Title: Tanganyika and Zanzibar
Blurb: The Republic of Tanganyika and the People's Republic of Zanzibar and Pemba unite to form the United Republic of Tanganyika and Zanzibar. Zanzibar City yields to Dar-es-Salaam as the capital.

Title: Democratic Republic of the Congo
Blurb: The Republic of the Congo (Congo-Leopoldville) changes its name to the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

Title: Tanzania
Blurb: The United Republic of Tanganyika and Zanzibar changes its name to the United Republic of Tanzania, which becomes a member state of the Commonwealth of Nations.

Title: Kenya
Blurb: Kenya is renamed the Republic of Kenya and severs all ties to the British monarchy as a Commonwealth realm, but remains part of the Commonwealth of Nations.

Title: Ma'an
Blurb: Jordan and Saudi Arabia sign a treaty significantly revising their mutual borders and resolving the territorial dispute over Ma'an.

Title: Da Nang
Blurb: The first 3,500 U.S. combat troops land in Da Nang, beginning an eight-year United States occupation of South Vietnam.

Title: Brussels
Blurb: The Merger Treaty is signed, establishing the European Communities between Luxembourg, Belgium, the Netherlands, West Germany, France and Italy.

Title: Cook Islands
Blurb: The Cook Islands become a state in free association with New Zealand, sharing citizenship.

Title: Romania
Blurb: The Romanian People's Republic changes its name to the Socialist Republic of Romania.

Title: Laguna del Desierto
Blurb: The Laguna del Desierto incident happened between Chilean Carabineros and members of the Argentine National Gendarmerie in the disputed area south of O'Higgins/San Martin Lake, which was occupied by the Argentine Gendarmerie after the incident.

Title: British Indian Ocean Territory
Blurb: The United Kingdom creates the British Indian Ocean Territory from the Chagos Archipelago in Mauritius and the islands of Aldabra, Farquhar and Desroches from Seychelles, as Mauritius claims the Chagos Archipelago.
Place: Diego Garcia, British Indian Ocean Territory

Title: Nigeria
Blurb: The Federal Republic of Nigeria changes its name to the Republic of Nigeria.

Title: Kinshasa
Blurb: The Democratic Republic of the Congo changes the name of its capital from Leopoldville to Kinshasa.

Title: Malawi
Blurb: Malawi changes its name to the Republic of Malawi and severs all ties to the British monarchy as a Commonwealth realm, but remains in the Commonwealth of Nations.

Title: Nigeria
Blurb: The Republic of Nigeria changes its name back to the Federal Republic of Nigeria.

Title: Ankoko Island
Blurb: Guyana discovers that Venezuela had sometime before occupied and effectively annexed Ankoko Island in the disputed Essequibo region.

Title: Rio Encuentro-Alto Palena
Blurb: The Rio Encuentro-Alto Palena Dispute between the Republic of Chile and the Argentine Republic is defined by arbitration by Elizabeth II.

Title: Burundi
Blurb: The Republic of Burundi supersedes the Kingdom of Burundi.

Title: Computerized tomography
Blurb: X-rays became a powerful diagnostic tool for a wide spectrum of diseases, from bone fractures to cancer. In the 1960s, computerized tomography was invented. Other important diagnostic tools developed were sonography and magnetic resonance imaging.

Title: Taipei
Blurb: Taipei becomes a special municipality separate from Taiwan Province, thus becoming the de jure capital of the Republic of China.

Title: Brazil
Blurb: The Republic of the United States of Brazil changes its name to the Federative Republic of Brazil.

Title: Israel and Arab states
Blurb: The 1967 Six-Day War, fought between Israel and a coalition of Arab states, primarily Egypt, Syria, and Jordan.

Title: Gaza Strip, Sinai, West Bank and Golan Heights
Blurb: Israel captures the Gaza Strip and the Sinai Peninsula from the United Arab Republic (Egypt), the West Bank (including East Jerusalem) from Jordan, and the Golan Heights from Syria as a result of the Six-Day War.

Title: European Communities
Blurb: The Merger Treaty comes into force, establishing the European Communities between Luxembourg, Belgium, the Netherlands, West Germany, France and Italy.

Title: French Territory of the Afars and Issas
Blurb: French Somaliland is renamed the French Territory of the Afars and Issas.

Title: Anguilla
Blurb: Following a referendum the day before, the Republic of Anguilla declares independence from the associated state of Saint Christopher, Nevis and Anguilla while seeking to remain a territory of the United Kingdom. The Valley becomes the capital.

Title: Bangkok
Blurb: With the signing of the ASEAN Declaration, the Association of Southeast Asian Nations is founded as a regional grouping of five states: Indonesia, Malaysia, Philippines, Singapore, and Thailand.

Title: Islamabad
Blurb: The capital of Pakistan is moved from Rawalpindi to Islamabad.

Title: Benin region
Blurb: Biafra takes over the Benin region.

Title: Uganda
Blurb: Uganda is renamed the Republic of Uganda, but remains in the Commonwealth of Nations.

Title: Republic of Benin
Blurb: The Republic of Benin is taken over by Nigeria.

Title: South Yemen
Blurb: South Yemen declares its independence from the United Kingdom as the People's Republic of South Yemen. Aden is the capital.

Title: Khuriya Muriya Islands
Blurb: The United Kingdom transfers the Khuriya Muriya Islands to Muscat and Oman.

Title: Czechoslovak Socialist Republic
Blurb: The 1968 Prague Spring, period of political liberalization and mass protest in the Czechoslovak Socialist Republic.

Title: Los Indios banco
Blurb: Mexico annexes the Los Indios banco from the United States of America.

Title: Bonin and Volcano Islands
Blurb: The Allied-occupied Bonin and Volcano Islands are given back to Japan.

Title: Czechoslovakia
Blurb: Four Warsaw Pact members, the Soviet Union, Poland, Bulgaria, and Hungary, jointly invade and occupy Czechoslovakia to stop reforms by the Soviet satellite government.

Title: Swaziland
Blurb: The Kingdom of Swaziland gains full independence from the United Kingdom. Mbabane is the capital.

Title: Albania
Blurb: Albania formally withdraws from the Warsaw Pact, having withheld support since 1961 over the Soviet-Albanian split.

Title: Maldives
Blurb: The Republic of Maldives supersedes the Sultanate of Maldives as a republic outside the Commonwealth of Nations.

Title: Lunar orbit
Blurb: Earthrise, taken on 24 December 1968 by the American astronaut William Anders during the Apollo 8 space mission. It is the first photograph taken of Earth from lunar orbit.

Title: Anguilla
Blurb: Following a referendum the day before, the Republic of Anguilla declares independence from the United Kingdom. The Valley remains the capital.

Title: Anguilla
Blurb: The Republic of Anguilla is overthrown by British forces and reincorporated into the associated state of Saint Christopher, Nevis and Anguilla.

Title: Bahamas
Blurb: The United Kingdom changes the name of the Colony of the Bahama Islands to the Commonwealth of the Bahama Islands.

Title: Sudan
